name: Traverse City Wine Tour
start:
if ! curl -sf http://127.0.0.1:3000/ >/dev/null; then nohup npx --yes serve -l 3000 --no-clipboard --no-port-switching . > /tmp/tcwine-serve.log 2>&1 & fi
for i in $(seq 1 30); do curl -sf http://127.0.0.1:3000/ >/dev/null && exit 0; sleep 1; done
echo 'static site failed to start' >&2
exit 1
